scope: Audit only the four unresolved routed mine-note rows preserved by SGC-02B for duplicate authority, multi-owner ambiguity and orphan ownership. This audit does not begin SGC-03 character-system coverage.

audited_rows.finding: Completed WCI-05 explicitly preserves distinct source and adaptation identity. CSW-08 separately defines derivative operations as new independent identities with exact source provenance. WCI is therefore the implemented runtime coverage owner for the retained distinction, with CSW as the derivative-identity design/supporting boundary; no parallel story database is needed.

The owner-approved amendment explicitly defines this as a shared invariant, not a feature program: semantic meaning, provenance and governing-owner authority must survive cross-system projection. A singular owner would be an invented duplicate authority.

The retained rule is intentionally partitioned across Inventory/Asset/Vehicle/Base/LSS owners. Canonical item design separates ownership, custody, control, access, possession/location and containment; LSS explicitly refuses a second inventory/vehicle/base ledger and preserves D17 Asset/inventory truth. The combined source row is not an orphan, but one owner_id would be false compression.

The source intentionally reuses Vehicles/Bases/Crafting/DPL/LSS rather than creating a machinery owner. LSS confirms D17 Asset/inventory truth, MIB-12 crafting/repair transformation authority, MIB-14 vehicle/platform/base/component compatibility authority and LSS object-decomposition jurisdiction. The concept is not orphaned; owner-specific coverage must remain split rather than collapsed.

invariants: A multi-owner boundary is not collapsed to one owner merely to close an audit row.
Shared invariants do not become synthetic feature programs.
No duplicate story, inventory, machinery, repair, vehicle/base or provenance ledger is created by SGC.
The two confirmed multi-owner partitions remain explicit inputs for SGC-04A/SGC-04C owner-specific coverage.
SGC-03A remains unstarted until separately selected and governed-started.
